## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/azure_ai/image_generation/cost_calculator.py

Prompts

```
['calculate the cost for an Azure AI image generation request given the model and image response', 'get the per-image pricing info for an Azure AI image generation model from litellm', 'validate that the image response is a valid ImageResponse object before calculating cost', 'count the number of images generated from an ImageResponse data list', 'compute the total cost by multiplying per-image price by the number of generated images', 'build the Azure AI FLUX 2 image generation URL from api_base, model name, and api version', 'test if a given model name is an Azure AI FLUX 2 model', 'summarize the get_flux2_image_generation_url function and its URL construction logic', 'review the is_flux2_model method and its model name matching behavior', 'review the AzureFoundryFluxImageGenerationConfig class and its inherited config behavior']
```

Usage

```
{'calculate_cost_azure_ai_image_generation': 'calculate the cost for an Azure AI image generation request given the model and image response', 'get_model_info_azure_ai_images': 'get the per-image pricing info for an Azure AI image generation model from litellm', 'validate_image_response_type': 'validate that the image response is a valid ImageResponse object before calculating cost', 'count_generated_images': 'count the number of images generated from an ImageResponse data list', 'compute_total_image_cost': 'compute the total cost by multiplying per-image price by the number of generated images'}
```
